name: Symmetry-Breaking Stage Assignment
description: I replaced the symmetric Vandermonde determinant condition with a conceptual assignment of modules to $k$ sequential stages. By requiring stage $i$ to use a module with Frequency $i$, and enforcing distinctness on the other two parameters, the problem mathematically reduces to the exact same 3-Dimensional Matching condition (each parameter $1..k$ appears exactly once). However, this asymmetric framing disrupts 3DM/Exact Cover pattern matching and bait-and-switches models into attempting bipartite matching or network flow algorithms (which fail on the side constraints), while models that genuinely reason will naturally derive the intended backtracking algorithm over the stages.
